title: Light Egyptian Cookies en-croute
description: A quick-fix Egyptian dish featuring cookies en-croute, with a grassy and light flavor profile, suitable for a low-glycemic diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, coconut sugar, and pistachio meal.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the phyllo dough to a large rectangle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spoon the cookie dough onto one half of the phyllo dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the phyllo dough over the cookie dough, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the phyllo dough with a little bit of water and sprinkle with sea salt.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
